tailoring.headline: Senior PIM Engineer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and end-to-end PIM-to-ERP/MDM data pipelines, API migrations and production support. Proven techno-functional consultant translating business requirements into robust integrations, leveraging CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and AI-assisted development. I have led code reviews, mentored junior developers and optimized database queries to improve performance.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Pimcore Engineer - PIM/MAM (d/f/m)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Ottobock’s mission to enhance human mobility through innovative prosthetic and orthotic solutions and to drive digital transformation of product data. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in PIM integration, API development and techno-functional delivery.

bullets.label: PIM Integration
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and built end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring accurate product data across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: I delivered robust OCC REST web services and engineered API migrations that enabled seamless integration of third-party systems and improved data consistency.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: I worked directly with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specifications, translating them into SAP Commerce solutions that met commercial goals.

bullets.label: Production Support & Performance
bullets.text: I led database query refactoring and provided 24/7 production support, reducing response latency and ensuring high availability of the commerce platform.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Ottobock is a global leader in prosthetic, orthotic and mobility solutions, continuously investing in digital platforms to deliver personalized products at scale. My background in building reliable PIM-to-ERP data pipelines and integrating headless commerce APIs aligns perfectly with Ottobock’s need to streamline product information across its digital channels, supporting faster time-to-market and superior customer experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to apply my proven PIM integration and API expertise to help Ottobock accelerate its digital product data strategy and support its mission of improving mobility for millions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce developer with 5+ years of PIM integration experience. I’m eager to bring my expertise to Ottobock’s digital transformation. Could we discuss how I can contribute?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will leverage my experience designing and implementing robust PIM-to-ERP data pipelines and OCC API integrations to accelerate Ottobock’s product data synchronization. I will also apply my production-support skills to ensure high availability of your commerce platforms.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Pimcore Engineer - PIM/MAM (d/f/m)
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience delivering PIM integrations and API solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Ottobock’s focus on digitalizing product data for innovative mobility solutions aligns with my expertise. I can immediately add value by building reliable PIM-to-ERP pipelines and ensuring seamless API integration. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
